title: Portfolio performance
explanation: TWR measures the change in value independently of deposit and withdrawal sizes. XIRR reflects their amounts and dates. TWR is annualized only for periods of at least 365 days; XIRR is not shown for periods shorter than 30 days.
range: Dates include flows from the first day; the baseline is the previous close. Table periods end on the latest available valuation date. Returns use the economic view; the view selector applies only to realized P/L.
gaps: Incomplete valuations or flows prevent calculation. An unavailable result does not mean a zero return.

drawdown.title: Portfolio drawdowns
drawdown.unrecovered: Not recovered within the selected period
drawdown.empty: No valuations in the selected period. Drawdown was not calculated; an unavailable result does not mean zero.
drawdown.incomplete: Incomplete valuations or flows prevent drawdown calculation. An unavailable result does not mean zero.
drawdown.noDecline: The TWR index did not fall below an earlier peak in the selected period.
drawdown.assumptions: TWR index in PLN, daily valuations, start-of-day flows
drawdown.explanation: Drawdown is the decline of the TWR index from its earlier peak. TWR adjusts for deposits and withdrawals. The range includes the previous close as its baseline when earlier history exists. Duration runs from peak to trough; recovery runs from trough to the first return to the peak, in calendar days. Drawdowns always use PLN, independently of the returns table currency.
drawdown.chartUnavailable: The chart is unavailable. Values are available in the data table.
drawdown.decimated: The chart and table series is reduced to at most 3,000 points. Maximum drawdown and durations use the full daily history.

exposure.title: Currency exposure
exposure.assumptions: EOD closes, NBP table A mid rates, economic view, FIFO
exposure.explanation: Positions are grouped by their quote currency and cash by the currency of the balance. Values in PLN use the latest NBP table A mid rate published on or before the valuation date. The quote currency of an ETF is not the currency of its underlying assets. The weight is the share of the portfolio value in PLN; negative cash lowers it.
exposure.decompositionExplanation: For open positions in currencies other than PLN, unrealized P/L in PLN is split into a price effect and a currency effect. Price effect = (value in the instrument currency − cost in that currency) × effective purchase rate; currency effect = P/L in PLN − price effect, so both add up to the P/L. Positions in an account kept in the instrument currency stay in the exposure but are left out of the split: their PLN cost is not recorded.
exposure.empty: No positions or cash on the valuation date. Exposure was not calculated.
exposure.incomplete: A missing price or exchange rate prevents the PLN total and weights from being calculated. An unavailable value does not mean zero.
exposure.noForeign: No open positions in currencies other than PLN with a known cost.
exposure.decompositionIncomplete: Some rows are unavailable because a price or exchange rate is missing. The total covers complete rows only.
exposure.exclusions: Positions left out of the split

reasons.account_currency: account kept in the instrument currency
